assumptions: Declared weekly hours and percentages describe a typical week.
Tasks within a responsibility receive equal time unless separated into their own responsibility.
Automatable savings assume clean structured inputs, stable rules, access permission and exception review: 60% to 85%.
Hybrid savings assume software assists and a human reviews every decision: 15% to 35%.
Human-judgment tasks receive zero savings; setup, adoption and data quality may reduce realized savings.
Ranges are heuristic scenarios, not confidence intervals or guaranteed outcomes.
